[1mDescription[22m:
Run foreground live performance collection (Ctrl+C to stop)

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli perf live run[22m [options]

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m--package <package_name>[22m  Target app package name (e.g. com.picoxr.example),
                            or "none" to skip app metrics
  [1m--app <package_name>[22m      Deprecated alias for --package
  [1m--adb <path>[22m              Path to adb executable (optional, overrides
                            ADB_PATH/PROFILER_ADB/PAT
